title: Python Software Architect
description:
Python Software Architect- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title : Python Software Architect
Location : 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type : Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range : $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required : 6+ years

Sponsorship:  U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Python Software Architect to design, build, and continuously enhance complex enterprise-grade applications, data-intensive services, and automation platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on delivering robust, secure, and high-performance Python systems that operate reliably within distributed and mission-critical production environments. The ideal candidate will bring deep Python expertise combined with strong fundamentals in software architecture, data engineering, and operational support, and will partner closely with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate ambiguous business problems into well-engineered technical solutions. You will be expected to think beyond surface-level fixes, identify root causes of complex issues, and proactively raise the engineering bar across the team.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for complex enterprise-grade Python applications, reaching beyond routine approaches to solve novel and non-trivial technical problems.

• Develop secure, high-quality, production-ready Python code and implement algorithms that perform reliably within distributed systems, with thoughtful consideration of concurrency, fault-tolerance, and observability.

• Produce architecture and design artifacts for complex applications, ensuring that day-to-day development adheres to defined design constraints, performance requirements, and enterprise standards.

• Develop and optimize data processing logic for large-scale datasets, including extraction, transformation, validation, deduplication, enrichment, and performance tuning to support both batch and near-real-time workloads.

• Gather, analyze, and synthesize large and diverse datasets to support continuous improvement of applications and business processes, surfacing insights that lead to measurable improvements in product, reliability, or cost.

• Develop reporting mechanisms, dashboards, and data visualizations where required to support operational insights, leveraging libraries and tools appropriate to the stakeholder audience.

• Identify hidden defects, performance bottlenecks, and architectural weaknesses, and proactively implement improvements to coding standards, system reliability, and overall maintainability.

• Contribute substantively to engineering best practices, conduct thorough peer code reviews, and participate constructively in architectural design discussions, mentoring less-senior engineers along the way.

• Participate fully in Agile development cycles and CI/CD processes, ensuring consistent, stable, and frequent deployments with appropriate testing, rollback, and monitoring strategies in place.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders - product managers, data scientists, operations engineers, and business analysts - to clarify requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions.

• Support operational stability through structured incident response, debugging, log analysis, and post-incident reviews in enterprise environments, contributing actionable preventative measures.

title: Senior Embedded Linux / Android Camera Engineer
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Join a long-term international engineering project delivered by Jabil and work on advanced embedded camera and video technologies for a global leader in smart automation and control systems.
This is an opportunity for an experienced Camera / Embedded Linux Engineer who enjoys working close to the hardware and deep inside the Linux and Android camera stack-solving the complex problems that happen where image sensors, drivers, kernel, ISP, multimedia frameworks, and Android come together.
You’ll contribute to a unified camera technology platform powering multiple product families used in conference rooms, classrooms, auditoriums, home offices, and enterprise environments worldwide. Your work will have a direct impact on camera performance, video quality, system stability, and the overall user experience of commercially deployed products.
Deep Camera & Embedded Linux Engineering
Rather than working only at the application layer, you’ll have the opportunity to investigate and solve problems across the complete camera pipeline, from hardware interfaces and Linux kernel drivers through Android and multimedia frameworks.
Solve Problems That Require Real Engineering
You may find yourself analyzing kernel logs and driver behavior, tracing frames through V4L2 and the ISP, debugging MIPI CSI-2 communication, investigating Android Camera HAL behavior, tuning GStreamer pipelines, or determining whether a difficult problem originates in the sensor, hardware interface, kernel, driver, multimedia stack, or higher software layers.
Technical Ownership & Global Product Impact
We value senior engineers who want more than a predefined list of implementation tasks. You’ll have the opportunity to own complex technical topics from investigation through solution, contribute to architecture and engineering decisions, and work directly with globally distributed technical stakeholders.
Required Expertise

Must have

• 8+ years of embedded/low-level development experience, with 4-5+ years focused on Linux / Android BSP and camera or multimedia subsystem integration

• Strong C/C++ programming skills

• Strong experience with Linux kernel camera drivers and V4L2 (including sub-device drivers )

• Proven experience integrating and maintaining Android Camera HAL

• Hands-on experience with camera sensor bring-up and board-level integration

• Experience working with Device Tree / DTBO overlays , including power sequencing , reset , and clock (MCLK) configuration

• Experience with ISP and image quality (IQ) pipelines , including:

•
3A algorithms (AE, AWB, AF) ,

•
Lens Shading Correction (LSC) ,

• Temporal Noise Reduction (TNR)

• Ability to debug complex camera pipelines across kernel and user space

• Experience with Git/Gerrit and build systems ( Yocto or AOSP )

• Strong understanding of embedded Linux and Android system architecture

• Experience with camera validation and debugging frameworks .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills , with the manner to effectively collaborate for the successful project delivery and to take ownership of complex technical challenges .

Nice to have

• Experience with Qualcomm’s CHI pipeline

• Experience with ISP pipelines and proprietary HAL implementations

• Knowledge of multimedia frameworks such as GStreamer or OpenCV

• Experience working with high-resolution or multi-camera systems

title: Technical Product Manager, Experimentation Platform
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of its experimentation platform. This is a role with global scope and clear accountability for the roadmap, prioritization, adoption, and success of a strategic platform that supports A/B testing today and will expand over time to broader testing use cases across the company! You will work closely with Engineering, Data, and Product partners and help a small cross-functional team deliver a platform that enables faster, more trusted decision-making across KAYAK.

Note, this position is required to work from our Concord, MA office 3 days per week.

In this role you will:

- Own the roadmap for KAYAK's experimentation platform, aligning priorities with business goals and platform needs.

- Define and communicate a clear product direction, from current A/B testing capabilities to broader testing use cases over time.

- Partner closely with Engineering, Data, and Product teams to shape features, requirements, and implementation plans.

- Translate user needs and ambiguous asks into clear product requirements and well-scoped initiatives.

- Define success metrics, drive adoption, and continuously improve the platform through data and partner feedback.

- Improve experiment setup, execution, monitoring, analysis, and decision-making workflows across the platform.

Please apply if you have:

- 4+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, or platform product management within a technology environment - equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are considered.

- Strong knowledge of experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing concepts, statistical foundations (significance, power, confidence intervals, multiple comparisons, and sequential testing), trade-offs, and common pitfalls.

- Experience owning complex products or platforms with multiple collaborators and technical dependencies.

- Strong product and project management skills, including roadmap definition, prioritization, and cross-functional execution.

- Comfort working with engineers and data practitioners on technically complex topics.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- High ownership, sound judgment, strong analytical skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders without direct authority.

- Experience reading and writing SQL.

Bonus points (not required):

- Hands-on familiarity with the statistics underpinning experimentation - power and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, multiple testing / false discovery, and sequential or group-sequential analysis.

Benefits and Perks

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

- Focus on mental health and well-being:

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

- Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

- Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

- No meeting Fridays

- Paid parental leave

- Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

- Paid volunteer time

- Focus on your career growth:

- Development Dollars

- Leadership development

- Access to thousands of on-demand

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there - as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer at BetterHelp , you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp , you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day - with a supportive community behind you the whole way.
What are we looking for?
BetterHelp is looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing Data team. In this role, you’ll help drive a range of impactful, ML-driven initiatives that power our products and improve outcomes for our users.
We’re seeking someone who brings a strong combination of machine learning, optimization, and software engineering experience. You’ll be responsible for designing and building machine learning and optimization models, as well as partnering closely with Data Scientists to productionize and scale their work. As a key member of the team, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Data Engineers, Software Engineers, and Product Managers, playing a pivotal role in shaping how machine learning is applied across the business.

• Partner with data scientists to troubleshoot and optimize complex data pipelines

• Work with product managers and business partners to gather requirements for machine learning models

• You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

That means building the shared surfaces, APIs, and front-end systems that connect experiences that were each built independently, and doing it without slowing any of them down.

This is a hands-on senior role. You'll own meaningful slices of the unified experience end to end - schema to API to UI - and you'll do it alongside a Staff Backend Engineer, mobile engineers, product, and design.

 

Why Join Us

Fanatics Collect is growing fast, and the unification work is the highest-leverage engineering investment we have: every new app, drop, and live format gets easier once the shared foundation exists. You'll work across mobile, web, and internal tools, with real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. Your teammates are passionate about the space and most of them are collectors themselves.

 

Product Context and Scale

Our surfaces reach millions of collectors across iOS, Android, and web, with live, high-traffic moments (breaks, drops, auctions closing) that make performance and reliability non-negotiable. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft.

 

First 90 Days

- Ship a meaningful, user-facing piece of the unified experience end to end.
- Build a working map of how Live, Marketplace, Instant Rips, Collections, and Topps actually fit together today - data models, identity, entitlements, and the seams between them.
- Establish working relationships with the backend, mobile, product, and design partners you'll depend on.
- Identify one piece of duplicated or divergent logic across surfaces and make the case for consolidating it.

 

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain fullstack features using Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel.
- Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post-launch metrics.
- Build and maintain reusable front-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on - and treat other engineers as first-class consumers of what you build.
- Contribute to cross-surface concerns like shared identity, entitlements, inventory, and navigation betwee

Your responsibilities will include:

• Excellent written communication skills.

• Provide support for audits, reviews, and regulatory submissions.
Reporting & Systems

• Provide analysis and insights for Board and ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) reporting.

• Enhance treasury systems and automation for cash and liquidity management.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

• 3-5 years’ experience in treasury, liquidity, or cash management roles (banking, payments, or fintech/crypto sector an advantage).

• Strong knowledge of liquidity risk metrics, cash forecasting, and banking operations.

Trabalhas uma lista de leads prioritizada e realizas o primeiro contacto sobretudo por telefone, complementando a abordagem através de email e redes sociais. O teu papel passa por perceber rapidamente se existe fit entre o potencial cliente e a solução, avaliar o seu nível de interesse e identificar se está preparado para avançar para uma conversa comercial.

A tua responsabilidade acompanha todo o processo até à reunião agendada. O fecho da venda fica a cargo do vendedor, mas continuas a ser co-responsável pelas oportunidades que geraste e passaste à equipa. O teu trabalho não termina quando a reunião é marcada: acompanhas a qualidade das oportunidades que crias, assegurando que cada lead qualificado está devidamente associado ao teu contributo e ao impacto que geraste no processo comercial.

O que vais fazer

- Trabalhar uma fila prioritizada de leads classificados com base no perfil e na intenção, fazendo o primeiro contacto principalmente por telefone e utilizando email e redes sociais como complemento.

- Qualificar cada lead com base num conjunto claro de critérios: este negócio tem o perfil adequado e este é o momento certo para conversar?

- Agendar os comerciantes qualificados diretamente na agenda de um vendedor de Field Sales, com pelo menos 48 horas de antecedência, e garantir a realização da reunião através de uma confirmação e de um lembrete no dia anterior.

- Sinalizar leads que demonstram potencial mas precisam de ser contactados num momento mais adequado.

- Encerrar os leads que não têm o perfil adequado, registando um motivo claro e honesto.

- Manter o CRM organizado: registos precisos, notas claras e estados atualizados. A pessoa seguinte no processo depende da informação que registas.

O que vais trazer

- Conforto ao telefone e capacidade para ter uma conversa próxima e útil com um proprietário de um negócio que não estava à espera da tua chamada.

- Capacidade para ouvir mais do que apresentar, percebendo a diferença entre uma oportunidade real e um simples “talvez”.

- Organização e consistência: trabalhas a lista, fazes o follow-up dentro dos prazos e manténs os teus registos atualizados.

- Capacidade para lidar com um “não” com naturalidade e manter uma energia constante ao longo de um dia completo de chamadas.

- Facilidade na utilização de um CRM e de ferramentas modernas de vendas, ou capacidade para aprender rapidamente novas ferramentas.

- Fluência em português.

title: Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager
description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.
About the company:
The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.
The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.
Key Responsibilities:

• Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.

• Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.

• Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.

• Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.

• Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.

• Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

• Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.

• Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.

• High attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software

• Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus

• This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

• Fully remote and full-time role.

• Paid time off.

• Yearly bonuses.

• Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.

• Competitive and timely salary.

• Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.

• Dynamic, creative work environments.

• Flexible schedule.

title: Field Access Manager - Diabetes - New Jersey/Hudson Valley
description:
The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM will help coordinate pull-through efforts for patients who have been prescribed the product, irrespective of channel (HUB, specialty pharmacy, etc.), provided proper HIPAA consent has been secured from the patient. The FAM will be expected to be the primary face of the Patient Services platforms within designated HCP offices. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients .
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Expand advocacy within HCP offices and equip the staff, through education, to navigate the access and payer approval process, identify access barriers that the HCP must act on to overcome, and highlight HCP actions that support patient access to therapy.

• Offer educational resources to support the entire patient’s journey by optimizing processes for prior authorizations/appeals/specialty pharmacy and addressing access issues.

• Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.

• Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.

• Work cross functionally and collaboratively with partners in Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Strategic Accounts and more to act as a process and payer expert. The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.

• Build and execute a strategic business plan to meet the needs of top accounts and ensure successful implementation of market access initiatives.

• Obtain and maintain knowledge and understanding of payer landscape, including specialty pharmacy and utilization management criteria, on a national, regional and local level so that you can act as a process and payer expert.

• Continuously strive to understand the alignment of Payer/PBM/SP and how national/regional pharmacy drug formularies impact market access in their designated geography.

• Assist in providing appropriate field insights to ensure support of all access and patient/payer support programs and resources offered by the company’s Patient Support Programs.

• Anticipate, navigate and address individual account and patient access issues that arise by partnering with all appropriate stakeholders.

• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

• All other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

• Bachelor’s degree required; Healthcare degree advantageous, including MS, RN, PA, PharmD, or similar advanced healthcare/scientific degree.

• 10+ years in pharmaceutical industry with experience in payer policy and patient access.

• 5+ years of experience in benefit verifications and/or prior-authorization requirements or equivalent experience in patient access.

• Knowledge of Centers of Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policies and processes with experience in Medicare Parts B & D.

• Knowledge and understanding of specialty markets, HUB/reimbursement services and patient access programs.

• Strong understanding of specialty product access/reimbursement processes including Patient Support Service

Jury consultants have an understanding of reliable research methods and possess a keen insight into human behavior, motivation, and decision-making heuristics. Educational and experience

Technical Skills
Microsoft Office Suite, Analytical software (such as SPSS), general understanding of presentation technology.

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

THE ROLE

Due to rapid global growth and the launch of our AI Materials Foundry, we are seeking an AI Materials Foundry Ecosystem Manager to join our Partnerships team and report directly to our Director of Strategy & Operations.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role you will be engaging the global partner ecosystem that accelerates the adoption of our AI Materials platform, which is critical for delivering next-generation semiconductor and advanced materials to market.

 

Your main focus initially will be establishing an active cross-cultural foundry member community across our Europe, USA, and APAC hubs.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Ecosystem Cultivation & Community Activation

- Design, coordinate, and host a comprehensive global engagement strategy across our AI Materials Foundry including member engagement and events.

- Build scalable partner collaboration frameworks.

- Act as the primary operational bridge for tech partners, enterprise clients, and elite research institutions across Europe, the USA, and APAC.

Cross-Cultural Operations & Project Management

- Manage day-to-day engagement with global foundry stakeholders.

- Coordinate cross-functional timelines between external partner teams and CuspAI leadership.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

- Partner closely with our Director of Strategy & Operations and Head of Partnerships to align ecosystem activities with our overarching roadmap.

- Collaborate with our AI Research, Computational Chemistry, and Product teams to channel partner feedback directly into the development priorities of our agentic platform.

- Work alongside marketing and PR functions to spotlight partner success stories, such as dramatic speedups in simulation workloads and novel applications in advanced materials research.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You have a genuine, explicit interest in how frontier AI can revolutionize materials science and a passion for bringing sustainable, impactful technologies to humanity.

- You possess a proven track record in ecosystem management, strategic alliances, or technical community building, ideally within a high-growth startup or fast-paced deep-tech environment, alongside substantial experience communicating and building relationships with executive-level stakeholders.

- You have experience independently creating and managing events and conferences, owning them end to end, from concept through delivery. Including initiatives run alongside or on behalf of Fortune 100 companies.

- You demonstrate extensive global cross-cultural experience, with a proven ability to engage and build trust with senior stakeholders across international borders (e.g. Europe, USA, APAC).

- You are a confident, charismatic communicator with direct experience hosting, moderating, and organizing both virtual webinars and premium in-person events for a technical audience.

title: RevOps Solutions Specialist
description:
ABOUT US

Curvion is a high performance RevOps & sales augmentation agency that installs and deploys enterprise-grade, AI-driven revenue engines and selling systems for our clients. Think of a lead generation based marketing agency…. But focused on sales! We design and install complete sales systems from sales processes and GTM strategy to CRM setup all the way to fully outsourced sales engagements. Then we enhance those systems with AI enabled tools and battle tested playbooks, and finally, we provide highly trained sales talent to help our clients execute so their revenue engine runs faster, scales efficiently, and performs consistently. In short, we build and power modern, AI-driven sales systems that help companies grow with clarity and control.

POSITION OVERVIEW: REVOPS SOLUTIONS SPECIALIST

The RevOps Solutions Specialist sits at the intersection of sales, RevOps, HubSpot, and solution design.

You’ll work directly in the sales process to understand prospective clients' current sales operations, identify gaps and opportunities, and translate those findings into a clear RevOps solution.

You need to know HubSpot extremely well, but this role is much bigger than HubSpot.

You’ll help determine what systems, workflows, automations, integrations, processes, and operational infrastructure a client actually needs. From there, you’ll help scope the project, define deliverables, build the SOW, and develop pricing.

In other words, you’re the person who helps turn:

"Here's our sales problem."

into:

"Here's what Curvion should build, here's how we'll build it, and here's what it will cost."

You’ll work closely with the sales and delivery teams throughout the deal cycle, helping ensure that what we sell is technically sound, properly scoped, commercially viable, and deliverable.

This is an agency role. You’ll work across multiple prospective and active client environments, each with different sales processes, systems, and business requirements. Experience working in a client-services environment is critical.

Ideal background: HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar technology/implementation agency.

YOU SHOULD APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- You have agency, consultancy, or client-services experience

- You’ve preferably worked for a HubSpot Solutions Partner, HubSpot agency, RevOps agency, CRM consultancy, or similar organization

- You’ve worked with multiple clients and HubSpot environments

- You know HubSpot extremely well and have built real-world systems

- You understand how sales teams actually operate, not just how CRMs work

- You’ve participated in discovery, solution design, scoping, or technical sales conversations

- You can look at a client's sales operation and quickly identify gaps and opportunities

- You can translate a business problem into a technical and operational solution

- You have experience creating SOWs, proposals, scopes, implementation plans, or project estimates

- You understand how to evaluate project complexity, effort, resources, and pricing

- You’re comfortable working alongside sales throughout the deal cycle

- You can explain technical concepts to executives and non-technical decision makers without making their eyes glaze over

- You can balance what the client wants, what they actually need, and what Curvion can realistically deliver

- You enjoy being the bridge between sales and delivery

YOU SHOULD NOT APPLY TO THIS ROLE IF:

- Your HubSpot experience has only been internal to one company

- You have no agency, consulting, or client-services experience

- You’ve never worked across multiple client environments

- You know HubSpot but don't understand sales or RevOps

- You don't enjoy discovery conversations or client interaction

- You've never had to scope a project or define deliverables

- You aren't comfortable thinking about project effort and pricing

- You need someone else to tell you what solution to recommend

- You prefer stay

Anduril’s Tactical Effects division (TFX) has two missions: 1) build highly capable and reliable autonomous drones, 2) deliver at scale to meet the needs of the warfighter. The team works across vehicles, compute, sensors, electronics and test infrastructure to turn engineering ideas into reliable hardware that can be built, commissioned, tested and scaled.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As an Engineering Technician at Wayve, you'll work hands-on with the vehicles, compute platforms, sensors and Hardware-in-the-Loop setups that support development of our AI Driver. You'll build, test, commission, diagnose and rework complex hardware systems, working closely with hardware and software engineers to resolve issues quickly and improve how systems are assembled, validated and maintained. This is a practical workshop-based role with direct impact on prototype vehicles and engineering development.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

• Build, test and maintain vehicles and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) setups with high-performance compute and sensor systems.

• Diagnose, repair and rework hardware system failures across compute systems, embedded modules, wiring harnesses, sensors and other hardware components.

• Collaborate with hardware and software engineering teams to execute one-off tests of hardware configurations and assist in troubleshooting issues.

• Maintain and manage workshop equipment, tools and inventory, ensuring an organised and efficient workspace.

• Support prototype assembly and modifications, contributing to the continuous improvement of engineering designs.

• Document workshop procedures, test results and system configurations to ensure reproducibility and consistency in testing.

• Support initial bring-up and commissioning of vehicles and contribute to overall system integration improvements.

• Stay up to date with emerging technologies and best practices in hardware systems, and bring practical tools such as 3D printing, Jira and AI-enabled workflows to workshop challenges.

🙌 You should apply if:

• You have a tenacious, hands-on mindset and keep working a problem through until it is resolved.

• You think beyond the immediate fix and understand the second- and third-order effects of technical decisions.

• You have hands-on experience building wiring harnesses and can confidently read and work from wiring diagrams.

• You have experience building complex systems in a fast-paced production or engineering environment.

• You have strong organisational skills and can manage multiple tasks effectively in a dynamic environment.

• You have excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities across complex hardware systems.

• You work effectively with engineering teams and are comfortable providing practical technical support when needed.

• You are passionate about learning, developing your technical expertise and contributing to the autonomy field.

Nice to have

• You have hands-on experience building and maintaining autonomous vehicle hardware systems, including vehicles, compute platforms, sensors such as LiDAR, radar and cameras, and wiring harnesses.

• You have prior experience flashing and commissioning hardware or embedded systems.

• You have experience with change management and version control systems.

This is a full-time role based in our London office.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Senior Business Analyst & Finance Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind Start to Finish.
Kein Startup kann wachsen ohne das richtige Team. Aus diesem Grund unterstützen wir aufstrebende Startups und Growth Companies wie Snocks, SellerX, Formary, Schema M und viele weitere dabei, ihre Schlüsselpositionen mit den richtigen Talenten zu besetzen.
Mit über 100 zufriedenen Kunden sind wir die #1 Recruiting Boutique für E-Commerce Startups im deutschsprachigen Raum.
Unser Kunde sucht Dich!
Als Senior Business Analyst & Finance Manager wirst du zum analytischen Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung. Du übersetzt Finanz- und KPI-Daten - bereitgestellt über ein modernes Data Warehouse und die Dashboards eines Data Scientists - in klare, datenbasierte Entscheidungsvorlagen für Wachstum, Pricing und Profitabilität.
Du agierst dabei als „CFO-light"-Business-Partner: Nicht primär in der Buchhaltung, sondern als die Person, die aus sichtbar gemachten Zahlen konkrete Entscheidungen ableitet. Der Fokus liegt auf SaaS-spezifischen Business Analytics - insbesondere Kohortenanalysen (Retention, LTV und Payback je Kundenkohorte) und Product-Led-Growth-Metriken - sowie auf der Pricing-Strategie und der engen Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Marketing, Product und Customer Success.
Ergänzt wird das durch ein schlankes Maß an BWA-/Kostencontrolling, Banking und die Qualitätssicherung der Buchhaltung - nicht jedoch das operative Tagesgeschäft der Buchhaltung selbst. Klassische Liquiditätsplanung spielt kaum eine Rolle: Durch den hohen Anteil an Jahreszahler:innen zahlen die Kund:innen im Voraus, wodurch typische Cash-vor-Leistung-Risiken entfallen.
Aufgaben

•
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Data Scientist: Übersetzung der bereitgestellten Dashboards und Datenbasis (Data Warehouse, CRM als Single Source of Truth) in konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsführung.

•
Analyse & Reporting: Regelmäßiges KPI-Reporting an die Geschäftsführung sowie Aufbau und Pflege von Kohortenanalysen und Umsatz-Forecasts auf PLG-Basis (keine Liquiditätsplanung, da durch Jahreszahler weitgehend irrelevant).

•
SaaS-spezifische Finanzsteuerung: Entwicklung und Aktualisierung von Pricing-Modellen, Reporting zu Preisänderungen und Monitoring der Wettbewerbssituation.

•
Monatliches Kosten-Screening & BWA-Aufbereitung: Detaillierte Analyse der Kostenpositionen und proaktives Aufzeigen von Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

•
Stakeholder-Management: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales (Provisionsberechnungen im CRM), Marketing (Tracking & Budgetfreigaben), Product (Produktmetriken) und Customer Success (Churn-Analyse).

•
Accounting- & Controlling-Optimierung: Enger Austausch mit dem Buchhaltungsteam, Prozessoptimierung und Prüfung gebuchter Positionen.

•
Koordination von Banken & Versicherungen: Verwaltung mehrerer Bankkonten und regelmäßige Prüfung von Anlagen (Tagesgeld, Versicherungen etc.).

Qualifikation

• 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Business Analytics, FP&A, Finance oder Controlling

• Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus Rohdaten und Dashboards konkrete Geschäftsempfehlungen abzuleiten (Business-Analyst- oder FP&A-Hintergrund von Vorteil)

• Verständnis von SaaS-KPIs, Recurring-Revenue-Modellen und SaaS-Kostenstrukturen

• Erfahrung mit Kosten-/BWA-Controlling und finanziellem Forecasting

• Sicherer Umgang mit KPIs, Reporting und datenbasierten Empfehlungen

• Sicheres Englisch für eine mögliche Internationalisierung

Von Vorteil:

• Erfahrung mit Kohortenanalysen (Retention, LTV, Payback) im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld

• BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Evidence)

• Verständnis von Product-Led-Growth-Modellen und deren Metriken

• Vertrautheit mit Buchhaltungssoftware (z. B. DATEV) und Buchhaltungsprozessen

• Erfahrung in dynamischen, skalierenden SaaS-Umgebungen

Benefits

•
100 % remote - arbeite von überall, ohne Pendeln.

•
Ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen.

•
Willkommensbonus: Einmalig 300 € brutto - als Dankeschön für den erfolgreichen Start.

•

title: Lead, Business Analysis
description:
Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.
About the role
At Moniepoint , as an Analytics Manager, you will use data to make better decisions, faster for the business. You will own metrics, measurement, experimentation and the analysis/data roadmap for a business area. You’ll use data to quantify business KPIs and conduct analyses to uncover unknowns, helping the business unit achieve its goals for acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and revenue. As a leader of the business unit, the role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and growth.
What you’ll do

• Strategic Leadership: Build a disciplined, exceptional analytical team. Develop and execute a comprehensive data and analytics roadmap and strategy

• Team Building & Management: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team of analytics professionals

• Data Insights & Analytics - including forecast building, business analysis and model development and productionisation. Drive the generation of actionable insights from data to support various business functions, including product, operations, marketing and engineering. What is our actual CAC per channel? Which customer segments are more/less engaged? What are our customers’ share of wallet - how can we use this? What is the typical behaviour of a Moniepoint consumer? What products cause the biggest incremental engagement?

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with growth, product, and engineering managers to ensure we collect the right data for meaningful business insights. Bring data leadership and rigour to our approach to product development. Build a strategic understanding of the business and structure complex projects to bring them to life.

Business: Growth

• Create and maintain the yearly forecast and budget for your products.

• Define the product's growth plan and lead execution across the entire funnel from acquisition through to monetisation and retention

• Own and optimise specific business metrics or commercial goals, covering the entire funnel from new user acquisition through conversion, activation, retention, and expansion

• Perform detailed product analysis covering the product management funnel with all its aspects, implementing changes into the buying funnel to improve conversion

• Design and execute A/B testing programs to optimise sales and conversion rates/adoption at each funnel stage

• Lead testing and optimisation efforts for the conversion funnel across offline and online channels, prioritising tests that drive the biggest business impact

• Improve the product's design and deploy experiments to improve lifetime value (LTV) and decrease churn

Technical: Data & Analytics

• Use deep, flexible, and comprehensive analytics covering the entire funnel from marketing acquisition to product usage

• Analyse user behaviour to improve the sales funnel and increase conversions, using advanced analytics to assess campaign performance and refine strategies

• Define and track growth metrics including customer acquisition cost (CAC), activation rate, retention rate, payback time, and revenue per customer

• Conduct cohort analysis and journey mapping to identify bottlenecks and optimisation opportunities

What you need to succeed

• +5 years in Analytics and Analytics Management.

• 2+ years in a management role managing teams and driving strategic initiatives

• Proven track record in a consumer-FMCG environment, preferably in a CPG or fintech environment

• Deep experience scaling product businesses, with demonstrated ownership of significant revenue targets
